Messages.Author: self biased
Messages.Body:
how does it work? do you put the four cards under it before or after it contests?

Unique.
Search your library (shuffle afterward) and/or ash heap for up to four cards requiring Serpentis  and put them on this card, face down and out of play (you can look at the cards at any time). This Ministry can play cards from this equipment as if from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). Burn this equipment if it has no cards on it.
Rulings
- Once in play, can be equipped from the minion it's on (rulebook action) by another minion that does not meet the requirements. [ANK 20180719-3]
- If it leaves play, the card on it is burned. [LSJ 20021128]

Messages.Author: Legion
Messages.Body: I believe it works the same way as with all contested cards. Card enter play face down and a text of the card completely ignored until the contests is ended.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> self wrote:

>
When the card is successfully played (before it enters contest).
